# typesafe-ai: guide

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Build AI-powered software with TypeSafe: System One models (flagship Jev) turn natural language and app state into typed judgments and probabilities composed in code. Use when a feature needs programmable common sense, when brainstorming what AI could make possible, or when a prompt-and-parse step could become a structured decision. Minimal query recipe: reference.md.

## Invocation

```text
/typesafe-ai <feature intent> [choice|noul|score]
```

## Boundaries

- If Markdown fails, try the normal page; if offline, use local docs/SDK types, say so, and never invent version details.
- Question ids never reach the model — put full meaning in the question.

## What the skill covers

- Docs — source of truth; read as part of the task
- Shape — work back from user-visible behavior to judgments
- Design judgments
- Compose & verify
